correctness.rationale: The proof is an exact partition by the center label. For a center not labeled 2, the only forbidden labelings of one blade are {0,1}-labelings containing a zero, so the blade enumerator is \(Q_m(x)=(1+x+x^2)^m-(1+x)^m+x^m\). The center-zero case has one additional forbidden global labeling, namely all peripheral vertices labeled 1. These disjoint cases yield the polynomial for every \(n,m\) in scope. The standalone checker independently tests the graph definition, Roman condition, coefficient vector, minimum, and total count on representative small pairs.

value.rationale: The generalized windmill is a standard infinite two-parameter block-graph family, and the full Roman weight enumerator is a natural invariant that strictly refines the minimum weight. The formula gives every coefficient, the exact total number of feasible functions, and uniqueness of the optimum, while the proof identifies a reusable blade factorization induced by conditioning on the universal center. This is a complete structural enumeration, not an arbitrary finite cutoff or a routine restatement of the scalar domination number.
